A research-track training on working with spatial features in R or Python — joining, aggregating, and analysing geographic data alongside Imago indicators.

**Planned content:**

- Reading and writing common spatial formats
- Spatial joins and area-weighted aggregation
- Working with administrative geographies
- Combining spatial features with Imago indicators
